newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Friday, with few fresh enquiries heard, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices remained at 54.00-54.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 53.75-54.00 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.25-53.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Prices were seen remaining weak next week amid slow foreign demand and poor supply due to the Ramadhan fasting month, dealers said.
They said European firms bought March SIR20 at 53.50 cents/lb fob Palembang late on Thursday against 54.00 previously.
